ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Unbalanced: Behind her rough but likeable personality, Tara is amoral and a borderline sociopath; while she can control herself in order to complete her objectives, she can fly into destructive rages. Her Geokinesis increases exponentially while in this state, but she can’t control it as finely. i mmor al Loyalty: Tara is Deathstroke’s lover, despite the large age difference between them (and her being underage as well). She is only loyal to him, and his manipulations always succeed with her. Markovian Bastard: Tara is the unrecognized daughter of the King of Markovia and half-sister to Geo-Force, the legitimate (if abdicating) heir. She is very resentful of being exiled along with her mother.
